workflow: Ingest historical data dictionary with admissible variables only, excluding forbidden variables.
Configure rolling window: train 730 days, calibrate 30 days, test 30 days, step 30 days.
At each rolling step, construct features from admissible variables (calendar, cost_ratio, current_load, horizon, lagged_load, load_statistics, observed_weather, recent_ramp, region_id).
Train predictive model on training fold, calibrate on calibration fold.
Optimize upward reserve sizing minimizing expected cost = cost_reserve*reserve + cost_shortfall*expected_shortfall, with horizon=60, cost_reserve=1.0, cost_shortfall=20.0.
Evaluate on test fold without using test_period_residual or future information; record metrics via verified workflow.
